UI_BN_Bs_breaker_demo_intro_f: {name} took buildings apart for a living. Doors and barricades are barely an inconvenience.
UI_BN_Bs_breaker_demo_intro_m: {name} took buildings apart for a living. Doors and barricades are barely an inconvenience.

UI_BN_Bs_breaker_locksmith_intro_m: {name} worked as a locksmith, and few things stay shut for long once he sets his mind to it.
UI_BN_Bs_civ_clerk_intro_f: {name} worked a register at a big-box store, watching the panic-buying start before anyone admitted what it was.
UI_BN_Bs_civ_clerk_intro_m: {name} worked a register at a big-box store, watching the panic-buying start before anyone admitted what it was.

UI_BN_Bs_civ_farmhand_intro_m: {name} worked the land on a family farm and knows hard, honest work.

UI_BN_Bs_civ_office_intro_m: {name} pushed paper in an office downtown, a life that feels like someone else's now.

UI_BN_Bs_civ_student_intro_m: {name} was just a student when the world ended, growing up fast ever since.

UI_BN_Bs_civ_teacher_intro_m: {name} taught school before the outbreak and still has a teacher's stubborn patience.
UI_BN_Bs_civ_trucker_intro_f: {name} drove long-haul routes for years, so being far from home is nothing new.
UI_BN_Bs_civ_trucker_intro_m: {name} drove long-haul routes for years, so being far from home is nothing new.
UI_BN_Bs_cook_caterer_intro_f: {name} cooked for weddings and wakes alike, and still takes pride in a hot meal.
UI_BN_Bs_cook_caterer_intro_m: {name} cooked for weddings and wakes alike, and still takes pride in a hot meal.

UI_BN_Bs_cook_line_intro_m: {name} ran the line at a busy diner and can make a meal out of almost nothing.
UI_BN_Bs_elec_electrician_intro_f: {name} wired houses for a living, and now eyes every dead fuse box like an old friend.
UI_BN_Bs_elec_electrician_intro_m: {name} wired houses for a living, and now eyes every dead fuse box like an old friend.
UI_BN_Bs_elec_lineman_intro_f: {name} climbed poles as a lineman through every kind of weather before the lights went out for good.
UI_BN_Bs_elec_lineman_intro_m: {name} climbed poles as a lineman through every kind of weather before the lights went out for good.
UI_BN_Bs_ex_soldier_intro_f: {name} did a couple of tours before coming home. The training never really left.
UI_BN_Bs_ex_soldier_intro_m: {name} did a couple of tours before coming home. The training never really left.
UI_BN_Bs_hobby_line_f: Before all this, she also had a knack for %1.
UI_BN_Bs_hobby_line_m: Before all this, he also had a knack for %1.
UI_BN_Bs_hobby_repairman: fixing whatever broke around the house
UI_BN_Bs_mech_auto_intro_f: {name} spent years under the hood at a roadside garage. Engines and generators are an open book.
UI_BN_Bs_mech_auto_intro_m: {name} spent years under the hood at a roadside garage. Engines and generators are an open book.
UI_BN_Bs_mech_machinist_intro_f: {name} worked a machine shop floor, and can still coax life out of dead machinery.
UI_BN_Bs_mech_machinist_intro_m: {name} worked a machine shop floor, and can still coax life out of dead machinery.
UI_BN_Bs_medic_nurse_intro_f: Before the outbreak {name} pulled long shifts as an ER nurse. Patching people up is second nature now.
UI_BN_Bs_medic_nurse_intro_m: Before the outbreak {name} pulled long shifts as an ER nurse. Patching people up is second nature now.
UI_BN_Bs_medic_paramedic_intro_f: {name} rode an ambulance for years as a paramedic, so blood and broken bones don't faze her.
UI_BN_Bs_medic_paramedic_intro_m: {name} rode an ambulance for years as a paramedic, so blood and broken bones don't faze him.
UI_BN_Bs_medic_student_intro_f: {name} was a med student when it all fell apart, halfway to a white coat that never came.
UI_BN_Bs_medic_student_intro_m: {name} was a med student when it all fell apart, halfway to a white coat that never came.
UI_BN_Bs_pers_alcoholic_f: These days a bottle is never far from her reach.
UI_BN_Bs_pers_alcoholic_m: These days a bottle is never far from his reach.

UI_BN_Bs_pers_smoker_f: She still keeps a crumpled pack of cigarettes close.
UI_BN_Bs_pers_smoker_m: He still keeps a crumpled pack of cigarettes close.

UI_BN_Bs_recon_ranger_intro_m: {name} worked the backcountry as a park ranger. Reading the land and moving quiet comes easy.
UI_BN_Bs_recon_scout_intro_f: {name} grew up scouting and hiking, and the wilderness never scared her the way the towns do now.
UI_BN_Bs_recon_scout_intro_m: {name} grew up scouting and hiking, and the wilderness never scared him the way the towns do now.

UI_BN_Bs_repair_handyman_intro_m: {name} was the handyman everyone called. If it was broken, he fixed it.
UI_BN_Bs_repair_super_intro_f: {name} kept an apartment block running as the super, so nothing falling apart is a surprise.
UI_BN_Bs_repair_super_intro_m: {name} kept an apartment block running as the super, so nothing falling apart is a surprise.
UI_BN_Bs_scrapper_intro_f: {name} scraped a living out of junkyards and scrap heaps, and can find use in anything.
UI_BN_Bs_scrapper_intro_m: {name} scraped a living out of junkyards and scrap heaps, and can find use in anything.
UI_BN_Bs_security_intro_f: {name} worked private security, the kind that doesn't end up in the brochure.
UI_BN_Bs_security_intro_m: {name} worked private security, the kind that doesn't end up in the brochure.
UI_BN_Bs_thief_burglar_intro_f: {name} made a quiet living taking what wasn't her own. Light fingers, lighter conscience.
UI_BN_Bs_thief_burglar_intro_m: {name} made a quiet living taking what wasn't his own. Light fingers, lighter conscience.

UI_BN_Quest_antibiotics_desc: I want to understand how this thing really spreads. Bring me {count} courses of antibiotics for the research -- and I'll teach you a thing or two about patching people up.
UI_BN_Quest_antibiotics_success: "Fascinating, and horrifying. Here -- let me show you what I've learned."
UI_BN_Quest_cigs_desc: I'd trade an arm for a smoke. Bring me {count} packs and I'm yours.
UI_BN_Quest_doll_desc: If you ever come across a little doll out there... I lost my daughter's when we ran. I'd just like to hold one again.
UI_BN_Quest_doll_success: "...yeah. That's the one. Thank you. I won't forget this."
UI_BN_Quest_drink_desc: Find me a bottle of something strong. Just one. Helps me sleep without the dreams.
UI_BN_Quest_drink_success: "...I'll make it last. Probably won't. Thanks."
UI_BN_Quest_escrap_desc: Get me {count} bits of electronic scrap and I'll show you how to keep the lights on after everyone else is in the dark.
UI_BN_Quest_escrap_success: "See? Power's just patience and not electrocuting yourself. Your turn."
UI_BN_Quest_fuel_desc: There's a place I keep dreaming about -- the dark down past the warehouses. I'm not ready to go back. Bring me a can of fuel and I'll tell you what I saw there. Take this torch; you'll want it.
UI_BN_Quest_fuel_success: "...the doors were chained from the inside. Whatever did that wasn't trying to keep things OUT."
UI_BN_Quest_games_desc: Stupid thing to miss, but I'd kill to play something again. Find me {count} old video games? Even if there's no power to run them yet.
UI_BN_Quest_games_success: "Ha! Look at that. Maybe one day we hook up a generator and a TV. Deal?"
UI_BN_Quest_generic_hunt: Thin the herd -- take down {count} zombies.
UI_BN_Quest_hunt_desc: I keep hearing them at night. Thin the herd for me -- {count} of them -- and I'll sleep a little easier.
UI_BN_Quest_hunt_success: "Quieter now. Thank you. Get some rest."
UI_BN_Quest_mags_desc: Anything to read would help. Bring me {count} magazines or comics and I'll be a happy idiot.
UI_BN_Quest_mags_success: "You're a lifesaver. Don't spoil the endings."
UI_BN_Quest_saucepan_desc: Find me a saucepan and I'll turn our sad cans into something that tastes like a memory. I'll teach you, too.
UI_BN_Quest_saucepan_success: "A hot meal changes everything out here. Take this pot -- and what I showed you."
UI_BN_Quest_scalpel_desc: For the next stage I need a proper scalpel. What I'm studying... it's not pretty. But it might matter. Help me and I'll pass on what I know.
UI_BN_Quest_scalpel_success: "...the things in their blood shouldn't move like that. Anyway. You earned this knowledge."
UI_BN_Quest_screwdrivers_desc: Bring me {count} screwdrivers and I'll teach you how to keep a car breathing. We don't get far on foot.
UI_BN_Quest_screwdrivers_success: "Engines don't lie to you. People do. Here, this'll help you."
UI_BN_Quest_soda_desc: Bit silly, but... could you find me {count} cans of soda? I just miss the taste. Normal things, you know?
UI_BN_Quest_soda_success: "...ice cold would've been perfect. Thank you. Really."
UI_BN_Quest_soup_desc: Food's been thin. Could you bring me {count} cans of soup?
UI_BN_Rec_food_prompt: "I'll travel with you, but I'm running on empty. Got any food to spare?"
UI_BN_Rec_food_refusal: "Sorry... bring me something to eat first."
UI_BN_Rec_none_prompt: "Honestly? I've got nowhere else to be. I'll come with you."
UI_BN_Rec_water_prompt: "My throat's like sandpaper. Got anything to drink? Then we'll talk."
UI_BN_Rec_water_refusal: "Not until I get something to drink."
UI_BN_Rec_weapon_prompt: "I'm not stepping out there empty-handed. Spare me a melee weapon and I'm yours."
UI_BN_Rec_weapon_refusal: "Find me a weapon first, then we'll talk."

UI_BN_TopicRX_rumor_farm_Cook: "Forget growing it -- it's about not wasting it. A root cellar, some salt, and I can stretch one deer through a whole winter. Find the food; I'll make it last."
UI_BN_TopicRX_rumor_farm_Tracker: "Follow the deer. Where they graze, the land's still good. There's an orchard gone wild south of the farms -- apples for the taking if the bears don't beat you to it."
UI_BN_TopicRX_rumor_farm_Trapper: "You don't need a farm -- you need a snare line and patience. Set traps along the game trails by the creek and you'll never go hungry. I'll show you the spots."
UI_BN_TopicRX_rumor_mil_Assasin: "I wore the uniform. The Knox facility wasn't a containment site -- it was a research lab. They knew weeks before they warned anyone. We were ordered to hold a line we were never told the truth about."
UI_BN_TopicRX_rumor_mil_Recon: "I scouted that perimeter before the fences went up. Heavy vehicles, comms towers, men who didn't answer questions. Whatever this is, it started behind those gates."
UI_BN_TopicRX_rumor_safe_Recon: "That forest bunker's no myth -- I've stood on its hatch. Concealed entry off an old logging trail northeast of the lake. Whether anyone's still home is another question."
UI_BN_TopicRX_rumor_safe_Tracker: "Safest place is wherever the herds aren't, and that changes daily. But the deep woods past the ridge? They don't wander up there. I'd build there if I were settling down."
UI_BN_TopicR_ban_cook: "Find me an onion and a little heat and I'll make you forget it's the end of the world. For one plate, anyway."
UI_BN_TopicR_ban_elec: "Give me a generator, some fuel, and ten minutes where nothing's trying to eat me. Hot showers again -- imagine that."
UI_BN_TopicR_ban_mech_1: "You treat the clutch like it owes you money. But you keep us moving, so I'll allow it."
UI_BN_TopicR_ban_mech_2: "Every time you grind the gears, a little piece of me dies. Otherwise? Not bad."
UI_BN_TopicR_ban_med_1: "That scratch says otherwise. Sit. Let me look before it turns -- they ALL turn now."
UI_BN_TopicR_ban_med_2: "'Fine' is what people say right before they spike a fever. Humor me and roll up your sleeve."
UI_BN_TopicR_ban_recon: "Spent years where the only map was the sky and the moss on the trees. Towns turn me around. The wild never does."
UI_BN_TopicR_ban_sold: "No. I don't. Some doors you don't open out here. Just know I'm good in a fight, and leave it at that."
UI_BN_TopicR_ban_thief: "Ha. Relax. Old habits, sure -- but I don't steal from the people who watch my back. ...Probably."
UI_BN_TopicR_ban_trap: "Rabbit, mostly. Fat one yesterday. Out here a snare line beats a gun -- quiet, and it works while you sleep."
UI_BN_TopicR_boss: "I'm not your dog. Watch your tone with me."
UI_BN_TopicR_deep: "With you? Maybe. For the first time, I think maybe."
UI_BN_TopicR_doubt: "That's rich, coming from you. Fine. Whatever you say, boss."
UI_BN_TopicR_flirt: "...I feel the same. Have for a while now."
UI_BN_TopicR_jeal_cold: "...wow. Noted. I'll keep my feelings to myself from now on, then. Lesson learned."
UI_BN_TopicR_jeal_confront_1: "...you didn't deny it. I don't know whether to be grateful you're honest or furious you did it. Both, probably."
UI_BN_TopicR_jeal_confront_2: "I won't ask you to choose -- the world's too small and cruel for that. Just don't make me feel like a fool."
UI_BN_TopicR_jeal_reassure: "...words are cheap, but I want to believe you. So don't make a liar of me. Please."
UI_BN_TopicR_joke: "Heh. That was awful. I needed it."
UI_BN_TopicR_learn_cook: "Heat, timing, and never wasting a scrap. Pay attention."
UI_BN_TopicR_learn_elec: "Rule one: assume every wire is live and wants you dead. Now, slowly..."
UI_BN_TopicR_learn_fight: "Alright. Breathe out when you swing, don't flail, and never back into a corner. Again."
UI_BN_TopicR_learn_mech: "Pop the hood. A car's just a thousand small problems that trust each other. Here."
UI_BN_TopicR_learn_med: "Sit. First rule: stop the bleeding, then worry about the pain. Watch my hands."
UI_BN_TopicR_nag_1: "...wow. I'm doing my best out here, same as you."
UI_BN_TopicR_nag_2: "Charming. Want to trade packs and find out how heavy it is?"
UI_BN_TopicR_rom_close: "...about time. Don't let go, alright? Not tonight."
UI_BN_TopicR_rom_fear: "Every single day. That's why I watch your back like I do. Don't you dare die on me."
UI_BN_TopicR_rom_future_1: "A house with a door that locks for the right reasons. A garden. You, complaining about my cooking. That's the whole dream."
UI_BN_TopicR_rom_future_2: "Quiet. Just quiet, and you next to me. I stopped wanting more than that a long time ago."
UI_BN_TopicR_rom_love: "...I love you too. Saying it feels dangerous, like it can be taken away. But it's true."
UI_BN_TopicR_rom_notice_1: "...I've noticed. I don't mind. Bit of warmth in all this -- I'll take it."
UI_BN_TopicR_rom_notice_2: "Yeah? And here I thought I was being subtle about watching you back."
UI_BN_TopicR_rom_open: "...then don't. I'm tired of pretending too. Whatever this is -- I want it."
UI_BN_TopicR_rom_partner: "You and me. To the end of it. I'm not going anywhere -- you're stuck with me now."
UI_BN_TopicR_rom_start: "...I was hoping you'd say that. Yes. Whatever this is -- let's find out together."
UI_BN_TopicR_rom_stop: "...oh. Right. No, I get it. Friends, then -- I'd rather have that than lose you."
UI_BN_TopicR_rumor_dark_1: "A school. I won't describe it. Just... don't go to the one off the highway. Promise me."
UI_BN_TopicR_rumor_dark_2: "They move different at night. In packs. Almost like they remember how to hunt. I don't sleep much."
UI_BN_TopicR_rumor_farm_1: "The farms out past the treeline. Animals gone feral, fields gone wild, but a smart forager eats like a king out there."
UI_BN_TopicR_rumor_farm_2: "McCoy land had logging cabins with stocked larders. Far from the roads. Far from help, too."
UI_BN_TopicR_rumor_loot_1: "Warehouses down by the river. Everyone hit the pharmacies first -- nobody thinks about the loading docks."
UI_BN_TopicR_rumor_loot_2: "The gun store in town was stripped day one. But the houses behind it? People left in a hurry. Doors still unlocked."
UI_BN_TopicR_rumor_loux_1: "The big city? They walled it and it didn't matter. Millions behind that concrete. If you go in, you don't come out -- but the mall never got picked clean..."
UI_BN_TopicR_rumor_loux_2: "Louisville's a graveyard the size of a county. Army dropped the bridges to slow them. Whatever's behind the wall is still in there, pacing."
UI_BN_TopicR_rumor_march: "March Ridge, maybe. Small, fenced. There were army trailers parked at the south end before the end -- supplies, if the looters left any."
UI_BN_TopicR_rumor_mil_1: "The Knox facility up north was ground zero. Whole region got sealed off -- nobody who went to look came back."
UI_BN_TopicR_rumor_mil_2: "There was a checkpoint on the bridge to West Point. By the end they were turning survivors away at gunpoint."
UI_BN_TopicR_rumor_muld_1: "Muldraugh's a one-road town -- gas station, warehouses, a sawmill. The horde rolls down Main Street like a tide. Loot the edges, never the middle."
UI_BN_TopicR_rumor_muld_2: "There's a storage lot in Muldraugh nobody bothered with. Padlocks, mostly. If you've got a sledge and nerve, might be worth it."
UI_BN_TopicR_rumor_river: "Riverside's quieter -- rich little river town. Big houses, full pantries, folks who locked up tight and never made it back. Watch the gated streets."
UI_BN_TopicR_rumor_safe_1: "People whispered about a prepper's bunker out in the forest. Could be a myth -- could be the last dry bed in the county."
UI_BN_TopicR_rumor_safe_2: "The Rosewood fire station had a solid setup before it got overrun. Might still be worth a look, if you're brave."
UI_BN_TopicR_rumor_signal_1: "A looping emergency message, mostly. But one night I swear I heard a real voice -- a woman, giving coordinates. Then static. I've wondered ever since."
UI_BN_TopicR_rumor_signal_2: "The official channels went dead weeks ago. Anything you hear now is either a recording... or someone who shouldn't still be out there talking."
UI_BN_TopicR_rumor_west: "West Point's got everything and ten thousand of them to guard it. The pharmacy and the gun store are gold -- if you can stand the noise you'll make getting out."
